clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Translate Abercrombie's Note brings a strange letter before the town's leaders. Mayor Ello Ebonlocke turns to Sirra Von'Indi, the scholar who knows obscure scripts.

Abercrombie sends Mayor Ello Ebonlocke a sealed letter from his home. Ebonlocke expects an eccentric plea or bitter ramblings from the cemetery hermit, but the parchment bears strange writing that ordinary Common cannot explain. Without the learning to read ancient or obscure languages, the mayor will not dismiss it. Even a mad hermit may pose a danger in Duskwood.

Ebonlocke sends you across the square to Sirra Von'Indi, Darkshire's scholar of esoteric lore. Sirra knows ancient arts and forgotten tongues. He scoffs at Abercrombie's sanity, saying anyone who lives beside a haunted graveyard must have a rotted brain. Still, he takes the parchment seriously and begins the slow work of transcription.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh? I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
